findings_of_record: F1 — the packet, not the floors, is the first gate: with 0 human band captures the §5.5 lane refuses at the packet check and the D5-beta floor list never fires; absence of an evaluation stays gated exactly as pre-registered. A future packet must satisfy capture >= 80% of its own answers, so the campaign must run smart marking on essentially every packet answer.

F2 — the raw material for a packet does not exist yet: 0 learner answers exist on any band part (the 4BS1/4GE1 band parts come from the G-4 ingested past papers, which no attempt has touched) — the capture campaign must first create attempts (probe/synthetic or served learners), then run the live band dispatch (G-6 serving), then have a teacher record bandPlacement captures through recordHumanMark (the hard range law: out-of-band or != marksAwarded = honest 409, never a clamp).

F3 — the point side is green fleet-wide and MUST stay per-kind: kappaGatePassed(POINT_UNWEIGHTED)=true on a 4BS1 band question (the 12 point-era ALL/PAPER rows, kappa=1.0) while kappaGatePassed(BAND_QWK)=false on the same question — the metric-kind-hard law is holding in production; a registry row with both kinds present flips only when EVERY present kind is green (the mixed-course flip law).

F4 — the 16-row cohort mixes two classes per the ingest-r1 census: band-scheme-deferred AND estate-skeleton; 14 of 16 additionally need G-3 (CIE 0455/9609 corpus legs) or an estate birth before the band infrastructure can even exist for them; only 4BS1/4GE1 are one capture campaign away from a flippable state.

F5 — runner transport fragility (the G-5 disclosure recurring): invocation 1 stalled >300s with zero output (NeonWsClient connect stall, output swallowed by a pipe buffer); the re-run completed its whole workload in ~10s of DB time. AFTER the result was written and all work completed, teardown raised an unhandled NeonWsClient 'Connection terminated unexpectedly' (exit 1, non-substantive — the of-record outcome is the written result + the byte-identity verdict). Lane transport remains one-WS-session-per-process; chunk or reconnect per phase for future long runs.
